name: Amnezia
author: rem-aster
description: Amnezia Premium in the Omarchy bar: pick a location, pick AmneziaWG or VLESS, connect — from a native panel with live traffic, recent places and your device slots.

barWidget.description: Amnezia Premium: click for the panel (locations, protocol, traffic, account and devices); right click connects to the picked location or disconnects.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the icon re-reads the tunnel state. Reading it costs no network; traffic is sampled every second while the panel is open.

schema.label: Show location
schema.description: When On, the country code of the live location sits next to the icon.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: Toggle connects to the picked location or disconnects. Nothing makes right click open the panel too.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: When On, a connect or disconnect started from the bar icon (with the panel closed) reports how it went.
